title: Functional organizer but SNACK is misspelled as SNACH; AMAZON photo must be Photoshopped
text:
Functional organizer but SNACK is misspelled as SNACH; AMAZON photo must be Photoshopped. The AMAZON photo for this product must be Photoshopped. This is a four-compartment organizer for different types of Ziplock bags (quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack) that cannot be hung. Even though it is functional, the snack compartment label is spelled snach (see my photo).

The unit does not open. All bags have to be loaded and removed through their slots. If this did not have the misspelling, it would have received 4 stars from me at the current price of $17.99. In its current condition, I would pass on this.

There are many other Ziplock bag organizer options available on the market such as this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]] or an individual heavy plastic set like [[ASIN:B09THNTBGX this]]. For a cheaper unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]] but no screws are provided with that one. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires. I personally like these other ones a little better than this one.

product_metadata.title: Puricon Ziplock Bag Organizer Acrylic Food Storage Bag Organizer for Drawer, Clear Baggie Holder Plastic Bag Container for Gallon Quart Sandwich Snack, Compatible With Ziploc Solimo Hefty Glad Bags
features: ✅ External dimensions: 12.6*11.81*2.76 inch, ziplock bags are NOT included

✅ Plastic bag storage organizer keeps your bag out of the clutter. 4 larger slots are designed to organize various size bags: quart, quart size slider bags, gallon, sandwich, and snack. No more falling baggies with this organizer box
✅ Transparent acrylic bag organizer box with labels makes things clear inside, see what size bags you need easily and pull baggies out quick; No Guesswork about how many bags are left
✅ Smooth edges prevent hand injury when you access bags; Sturdy and durable material prevents cracking. Easy to clean with paper or wash with water
✅ No installation need, the organizer box comes fully assembled and easy to put in and take out, don't worry about deforming the bags when putting it in
